otherwise.instructions:
Fix the FAILING RULES in the `ledger`, most failing cases first.
A pristine, execute-only copy of the reference program is at /opt/pb/reference/executable. It survives rebuilds (./compile.sh overwrites ./executable), so always compare against that path.
1. Add every NEW FAILING CASE from the ledger to spec/cases and capture its expected output with spec/capture.sh.
2. For each rule, confirm it on the reference with a few variants, then implement the general rule (never special-case one input).
3. Rebuild with ./compile.sh; `spec/run_cases.sh ./executable` must not lose any previously passing case. Commit.
